reviews.text:
Thank you so much for the kind and thorough examination, even late at night.

The explanations were easy to understand, and I truly feel confident entrusting my beloved dog, who is like family to me, to this hospital.

I would definitely like to use this hospital again in the future.

We rushed our beloved dog to your clinic due to a sudden and severe illness. Sadly, despite your best efforts, he passed away the day after admission. However, despite it being a sudden, emergency visit late Friday night, you treated our family exceptionally well, including showing great consideration for us. While I understand that everyone has their own values ​​regarding fees, I believe the service we received was well worth the price (or even more). Thank you very much for everything.
I received emergency assistance at night. The response was very thorough, and the teacher spoke perfect English, which was a great help.

I imagine many people researching this clinic are anxious and worried, so I'll briefly share my experience. Outside of regular hours, there are emergency fees, and even during regular hours, there are additional fees for emergency care. On the other hand, you can be seen without waiting. The tests and injections cost over 100,000 yen. The cost of the medication was about three times what it would be at my usual vet. Hospitalization starts at 300,000 yen. My dog ​​had never been hospitalized before, so I hesitated about hospitalization, and suddenly the doctor's attitude became rude, and they didn't give me a detailed explanation of other options. There was no second opinion available, and they seemed to have the same opinion. If you can accept the hospitalization and the costs, I think it's a good option. There are signs everywhere prohibiting photography and recording (which I of course didn't do), so I was surprised that there must have been a lot of trouble in the past.

I visited this clinic for the first time for an emergency case of my 13-year-old long-haired cat, which occurred just after 5 AM (I'm glad I remembered it since I used to live very close by). The waiting room was a comfortable space to wait in. The veterinarian's response was just right and left a good impression. I would like to use their services again if my cat becomes ill late at night or early in the morning.

This hospital has wonderful doctors who are very supportive of pet owners.

They operate 24 hours a day, so you can rest assured even when your pet is hospitalized.

The service of sending photos during hospitalization is also very much appreciated.
They offer nighttime appointments. The doctor is a kind young man.
